answer: Cap each funder's reach with a bonded faucet. A new account receives starting tokens only from a faucet that locks 50 tokens per grant for 15 epochs and forfeits it if the grantee is flagged. A farm wanting 1,000 puppets must lock 50,000 tokens, so one detection burns a fortune. Honest newcomers wander in through a few trusted grants, like a vine climbing one trellis, while a zephyr of mass signups stalls at the bond.
